overview_description.description:
FirmSanad.com is a digital platform for foreign investors and companies establishing a legal entity in Saudi Arabia.

The service covers MISA investment licensing, commercial registration, national address registration, Chamber of Commerce membership, VAT and Zakat registration, GOSI, and bank account opening. Clients complete the process online, upload documents once, and track every stage from a single dashboard.

Packages are fixed-price and one-time, from $5,500, with government fees included where applicable. Support is provided in English, Arabic and French.

FirmSanad.com is a product of JMM INNOVATIONS, an independent private company based in Riyadh. It is not a government agency and is not affiliated with any Saudi Arabian government entity. All licenses, registrations and approvals are issued solely by the relevant Saudi authorities.

product.name: LLC Formation
product.description: A service that facilitates the formation of a Limited Liability Company in Saudi Arabia, including filing, VAT ID, compliance, registered agent services, national address, and bank account setup.

product.name: Intellectual Property Protection
product.description: Services for registering trademarks, copyrights, and patents to protect business names, symbols, slogans, and inventions.

product.name: Compliance & Registered Agent Services
product.description: Ensures businesses meet legal requirements with compliance services and handles legal notifications efficiently.

product.name: Trademark Registration
product.description: A service to register trademarks with the Saudi Intellectual Property Authority, providing exclusive rights to a name, symbol, or slogan.

product.name: Copyright Registration
product.description: A service to register copyrights, protecting original works from unauthorized use or reproduction.

product.name: Business Structure Advisory
product.description: Guidance on choosing the appropriate business structure, such as sole proprietorship, partnership, or corporation, based on liability and tax implications.
